_doc: Gold standard for retrieval eval. Copy to gold_dataset.json and fill one entry per query. Two ground-truth signals per entry, consumed by two independent eval paths: (1) expected_chunks[].content_hash — deterministic anchor (set intersection, reproducible, no LLM); the hash is the chunk's content fingerprint from dump_chunks.py / chunks_registry.json (NOT the _key UUID, which churns on re-ingest). (2) reference_answer — semantic ground truth for the LLM-judge path (Ragas faithfulness/context_recall/answer_relevancy). categoryLabel/serviceLabels/language mirror the payload the backend sends to chatqna (drives label-filtered retrieval) — keep them faithful to a real user flow.
